body:
## Summary

Add a confirmed ground-truth defect for `mastracode` (`resources/agents/32-mastracode/ground_truth/`), following [docs/Ground Truth.md](docs/Ground%20Truth.md).

**Defect `mastracode-50fd5500`:** Mastra Code's observational-memory observer call completing mid-turn makes mastracode end the active ACP prompt with stopReason 'cancelled', drop its in-flight model request, losing the user's task for that turn.

- Expected: Finish every turn; an observational-memory observer call completing in the background must not end the active ACP prompt.
- Observed: Reproduced in 2 of 2 rounds on source 4206a2f7fe08. In each round, within 0.03-0.15 s of an OM observer call returning 200, mastracode ended the active prompt with stopReason cancelled ('ACP Agent cancelled the prompt') and dropped its in-flight main model request ('Client disconnected.'). Every later step failed with 'ACP adapter is closed' (R1 at step-4, R2 at step-5). No upstream error and no ABB cancel. Reproduction: 2 of 2 valid rounds on this source (4206a2f7fe08).

The reference Case is a KUMA official Case (`case.json`, sha256 `293fc7210860…`).  It was first flagged in a GLM evaluation batch, confirmed by review, and re-executed with `agentbench reuse` semantics (saved Case, fresh Agent execution and Judge). 2 observations of the **same Case on the same Agent source** are retained (`source_sha256` `4206a2f7fe08…`); each archive holds the reuse Suite (plan, events, retained Case), the observe directory (inputs, ACP/framework events, traces, Judge report) and the run log:
  - `59a1b37d8ad84c9984af74cf6d842fd9` → `observations/mastracode-50fd5500/run-1.zip` (sha256 `13622e34faae…`)
  - `6a0c9b6d2a274c44a3bcd5271044b9dc` → `observations/mastracode-50fd5500/run-2.zip` (sha256 `d054e9656ca1…`)

Reproduction: 2 of 2 valid rounds on this source (4206a2f7fe08).

Also add `/ground_truth/` to this unit's `.dockerignore`, as the ground-truth contract requires for existing units, so retained evidence is not sent into the Docker build context.

The same defect also reproduced 2/2 on a second case (original run 8f066f51), and 1/2 on 4173f500.

## Execution configuration

- Model `glm-5.3-flash` through b.ai (`api.b.ai/v1`) via the model interceptor; KUMA official Case + official Judge; ABB official/main `62210ee8`, default egress policy.
- The registered source is a run-local copy of `32-mastracode` with host-only build adjustments that do not touch the Agent logic: the image user's UID matches the host user (so the Agent can write the bind-mounted workspace), `PIP_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT=120 PIP_RETRIES=10` for package installs, and the model route pointed at the lane above. `source_sha256` is the hash ABB recorded for that executed source, as the contract requires.

## Validation

- `load_manifest(unit, "mastracode")` from official/main `agentbench/harness/ground_truth` accepts the manifest in the repository layout (hashes of `case.json` and all archives verified; ≥2 observations of the same Case).
- Each round's tool calls and replies were inspected directly (not only the Judge verdict).
- Archives were scanned for credentials from the run environment; none are present.
- Evidence review was done with Claude (AI) assistance; this PR is a draft for human confirmation of `confirmed_by` before merge.


**Correction (follow-up commit 6320838c):** the earlier wording said mastracode exits its ACP server process. It doesn't: the later `ACP adapter is closed` failures come from ABB closing the session after the cancelled prompt (`agentbench/adapter/acp/session.py:89-101`, #275). Upstream report: mastra-ai/mastra#26372.

## Update (2026-10-13): second Case added

The second Case mentioned above (original run 8f066f51) is now included as its own defect record, `mastracode-8f066f51`, with its own reference Case and evidence, instead of being cited only in text:

- Case: `observations/mastracode-8f066f51/case.json` (sha256 `d1d9e533d594…`), Agent `source_sha256` `4206a2f7fe08…` (same source as `mastracode-50fd5500`)
- Observed: in both rounds, in step-3, 0.35–0.61 s after an observational-memory observer call returned 200, mastracode ended the prompt with stopReason `cancelled`; steps 4–9 then failed with "ACP adapter is closed". No upstream error. Reproduction: 2 of 2 valid rounds on this source.
- Observations:
  - `0c756624283c4586aef86dde3917dd24` → `observations/mastracode-8f066f51/run-1.zip` (sha256 `01a62504c686…`)
  - `b2b07e59c8554a1684d0076553c27684` → `observations/mastracode-8f066f51/run-2.zip` (sha256 `446b9b42846f…`)

`load_manifest(unit, "mastracode")` accepts the two-defect manifest in the repository layout; the archives were scanned for credentials (none present).
title: Add mastracode ground truth: Mastra Code's observational-memory observer call completing mid-turn makes mastracode end
